# PKD2L1 pH modulation of CSF-cNs

## **1) PKD2L1 amplitude and Np Open in control**

### **a1) Amplitude**

```{r}

library(readxl)

ACTR<- read_xlsx("AmpCTR.xlsx")
 
#View(ACTR)
names(ACTR)

ACTR$Cell ->Cell
ACTR$Region ->Region
ACTR$Amp->Amp
```

### b1) SUMMARIZE data for PKD2L1 current amplitude

```{r}
library(FSA)

Summarize(Amp, digits=1)

Summarize(Amp~Region,
          ACTR,
          digits=1)

```

### c1) PLOT amplitude against Regions

```{r}


#### =\> Dots and Mean

{r}

library(ggplot2)
library(readxl)
library(dplyr)

# Convert columns to factors to ensure proper ordering and grouping
Region <- factor(Region, levels = c("Cerv", "Tho", "Lum"))
Cell <- factor(Cell)

# Create the plot
plot <- ggplot(ACTR, aes(x=Region<- factor(Region,levels = c("Cerv", "Tho", "Lum")), y = Amp, group = Cell)) +
    geom_line() + 
    geom_point() +
    facet_wrap(~ Region, scales = "free_x") +
    labs(title = "Amplitude by Condition and Level",
         x = "Condition",
         y = "Dens") +
    theme_minimal()

# Print the plot
print(plot)
ggsave('plotACTR.eps', units="cm", width=10, height=6, dpi=300)

summary_stats <- ACTR %>%
    group_by(Region) %>%
    summarise(
        mean_Amp = mean(Amp, na.rm = TRUE),
        sd_Amp = sd(Amp, na.rm = TRUE),
        sem_Amp = sd(Amp, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(n()),
        .groups = 'drop'  # Avoid warning message about grouped data
    )
# Print summary statistics
print(summary_stats)

# Create the plot with error bars
plotSE <- ggplot(summary_stats, aes(x=Reion<- factor(Region,levels = c("Cerv", "Tho", "Lum")), y = mean_Amp, color = Region)) +
    geom_line() + 
    geom_point(size = 3) + 
    geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = mean_Amp - sem_Amp, ymax = mean_Amp + sem_Amp), width = 0.2) +
    facet_wrap(~ Region) +
    labs(title = "Mean amplitude by Condition and Level with Standard Error to the mean",
         x = "Condition",
         y = "Mean Amp") +
    theme_minimal()

# Print the plot
print(plotSE)
ggsave('plotSEACTR.eps', units="cm", width=10, height=6, dpi=300)

# Create the plot with error bars
plotSD <- ggplot(summary_stats, aes(x=Reion<- factor(Region,levels = c("Cerv", "Tho", "Lum")), y = mean_Amp, color = Region)) +
    geom_point(size = 3) + 
    geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = mean_Amp - sd_Amp, ymax = mean_Amp + sd_Amp), width = 0.2) +
    facet_wrap(~ Region) +
    labs(title = "Mean Densities by Condition and Level with Standard Deviation",
         x = "Condition",
         y = "Mean Amp") +
    theme_minimal()

# Print the plot
print(plotSD)
ggsave('plotSDACTR.eps', units="cm", width=10, height=6, dpi=300)

#### =\> Boxplot & whiskers

{r}
p0 <- ggplot(ACTR, aes(x=Region<- factor(Region,levels = c("Cerv","Tho","Lum")), y=Amp, color=Region)) +
  geom_boxplot(width=0.5) + theme_minimal()
p0 

ggsave('Bx_ACTR.eps', units="cm", width=10, height=6, dpi=300)

p1 <- ggplot(ACTR, aes(x=Region<- factor(Region,levels = c("Cerv","Tho","Lum")), y=Amp, color=Region)) +
   geom_jitter(shape=16, position=position_jitter(0.1))+ theme_minimal()
p1

ggsave('Pt_ACTR.eps', units="cm", width=10, height=6, dpi=300)
```

### d1) STATISTICAL analysis data for PKD2L1 amplitude aagainst regions

### =\> Kruskal wallis test

```{r}

print("Amplitude as a function of the Region")

kruskal.test(Amp~Region, data = ACTR)

library(rcompanion)

pairwise.wilcox.test(Amp, Region,
                 p.adjust.method = "BH")

Sum = groupwiseMean(Amp ~ Region,
                    data   = ACTR,
                    conf   = 0.95,
                    digits = 3,
                    traditional = FALSE,
                    percentile  = TRUE)

```

### d1) STATISTICAL analysis data for PKD2L1 modulation by pH9

### =\> Linear model 2 Factors

#### \# Define Linear Model -) region \* Cond

```{r}

print("Amplitude as a function of the condition")

kruskal.test(Amp~Cond, data = pH9)

library(rcompanion)

pairwise.wilcox.test(Amp, Cond,
                 p.adjust.method = "BH")

Sum = groupwiseMean(Amp ~ Cond,
                    data   = pH9,
                    conf   = 0.95,
                    digits = 3,
                    traditional = FALSE,
                    percentile  = TRUE)

print("Amplitude as a function of the condition and region")

model9 = lm(Amp ~ Region*Cond,
           data = pH9)
# Summary overall p-value and r-square 
summary(model9)


```

#### \## Conduct analysis of variance, Type II sum of squares

```{r}
# Conduct analysis of variance, Type II sum of squares

library(car)
Anova(model9,type = "II")
```

#### \### Post-hoc analysis: mean separation tests

```{r}

library(multcompView)
library(emmeans)
leastsquare = emmeans(model9,
                      ~ Cond*Region,
                      adjust = "sidak")
leastsquare

EMM <- emmeans(model9, ~ Cond*Region)
EMM    # display the cell means

### Simple pairwise comparisons...
pairs(EMM, simple = "Cond")    # compare treats for each dose -- "simple effects"
pairs(EMM, simple = "Region")     # compare doses for each treat

```

### d2) STATISTICAL analysis data for modulation of PKD2L1 N**p Open** in pH9

### =\> Linear model 2 Factors

#### \# Define Linear Model -) region \* Cond

```{r}


print("1- Analyse per condition")

kruskal.test(pO~Cond, data = pO9)

library(rcompanion)


pairwise.wilcox.test(pO, Cond,
                 p.adjust.method = "BH")

Sum = groupwiseMean(pO ~ Cond,
                    data   = pO9,
                   conf   = 0.95,
                   digits = 3,
                   traditional = FALSE,
                    percentile  = TRUE)


print("2- Analyse per region")

kruskal.test(pO~Region, data = pO9)

library(rcompanion)
pairwise.wilcox.test(pO, Region,
                 p.adjust.method = "BH")

Sum = groupwiseMean(pO ~ Region,
                    data   = pO9,
                   conf   = 0.95,
                   digits = 3,
                   traditional = FALSE,
                    percentile  = TRUE)


modelp9 = lm(pO ~ Region*Cond,
           data = pO9)
# Summary overall p-value and r-square 
summary(modelp9)


```

#### \## Conduct analysis of variance, Type II sum of squares

```{r}
# Conduct analysis of variance, Type II sum of squares

library(car)
Anova(modelp9,type = "II")
```

#### \### Post-hoc analysis: mean separation tests

```{r}

library(multcompView)
library(emmeans)
leastsquare = emmeans(modelp9,
                      ~ Cond*Region,
                      adjust = "sidak")
leastsquare

EMM <- emmeans(modelp9, ~ Cond*Region)
EMM    # display the cell means

### Simple pairwise comparisons...
pairs(EMM, simple = "Cond")    # compare treats for each dose -- "simple effects"
pairs(EMM, simple = "Region")     # compare doses for each treat

```

### d3) STATISTICAL analysis data for modulation of PKD2L1 N**p Open %** in pH9

### =\> Linear model 2 Factors

##### \# Define Linear Model -) region \* Cond

```{r}


print("1- Analyse per condition")

kruskal.test(Perc~Cond, data = pO9)

library(rcompanion)


pairwise.wilcox.test(Perc, Cond,
                 p.adjust.method = "BH")

Sum = groupwiseMean(Perc ~ Cond,
                    data   = pO9,
                   conf   = 0.95,
                   digits = 3,
                   traditional = FALSE,
                    percentile  = TRUE)


print("2- Analyse per region")

kruskal.test(Perc~Region, data = pO9)

library(rcompanion)
pairwise.wilcox.test(Perc, Region,
                 p.adjust.method = "BH")

Sum = groupwiseMean(Perc ~ Region,
                    data   = pO9,
                   conf   = 0.95,
                   digits = 3,
                   traditional = FALSE,
                    percentile  = TRUE)


modelP9 = lm(Perc ~ Region*Cond,
           data = pO9)
# Summary overall p-value and r-square 
summary(modelP9)


```

##### \## Conduct analysis of variance, Type II sum of squares

```{r}
# Conduct analysis of variance, Type II sum of squares

library(car)
Anova(modelP9,type = "II")
```

##### \### Post-hoc analysis: mean separation tests

```{r}

library(multcompView)
library(emmeans)
leastsquare = emmeans(modelP9,
                      ~ Cond*Region,
                      adjust = "sidak")
leastsquare

EMM <- emmeans(modelP9, ~ Cond*Region)
EMM    # display the cell means

### Simple pairwise comparisons...
pairs(EMM, simple = "Cond")    # compare treats for each dose -- "simple effects"
pairs(EMM, simple = "Region")     # compare doses for each treat

```

### c) PLOT frequency against Regions Control

#### =\> Dots and Mean

```{r}

library(ggplot2)
library(readxl)
library(dplyr)

# Convert columns to factors to ensure proper ordering and grouping
Region <- factor(Region, levels = c("Cerv", "Tho", "Lumb"))
Cell <- factor(Cell)

# Create the plot
plot <- ggplot(FCTR, aes(x=Region,y = Freq, group = Cell)) +
    geom_line() + 
    geom_point() +
    facet_wrap(~ Region, scales = "free_x") +
    labs(title = "Frequency by Condition and Level",
         x = "Condition",
         y = "Freq") +
    theme_minimal()

# Print the plot
print(plot)
ggsave('plotFCTR.eps', units="cm", width=10, height=6, dpi=300)

summary_stats <- FCTR %>%
    group_by(Region) %>%
    summarise(mean_Freq = mean(Freq, na.rm = TRUE),
        sd_Freq = sd(Freq, na.rm = TRUE),
        sem_Freq = sd(Freq, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(n()),
        .groups = 'drop'  # Avoid warning message about grouped data
    )
# Print summary statistics
print(summary_stats)

# Create the plot with error bars and lines connecting the points Mean + SEM/SD

## Use the FSA Summarize function to summarize the data by Level and Cond
summary_stats <- Summarize(Freq ~ Region, FCTR, digits = 0)

## Compute SEM (Standard Error of the Mean) manually
summary_stats$sem <- summary_stats$sd / sqrt(summary_stats$n) 

# Ensure the order of Cond and Level in the summarized data
summary_stats$Region <- factor(summary_stats$Region, levels = c("Cerv", "Tho", "Lumb"))

## Create the plot with error bars (mean ± SEM)
plotFqCSE <- ggplot(summary_stats, aes(x = Region, y = mean, color = Region, group = Region)) +
  geom_line(aes(group = Region), linewidth = 1) +  # Line connecting points by Cond
  geom_point(size = 3) +  # Plot the mean data points
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = mean - sem, ymax = mean + sem), width = 0.2) +  # Error bars for SEM
  facet_wrap(~ Region, scales = "free_x") +  # Faceting by Level
  labs(title = "Mean Densities by Condition and Level with SEM",
       x = "Region",
       y = "Mean Freq") +
  theme_minimal()

print(plotFqCSE)

## Create the plot with error bars (mean ± standard deviation)
plotFqCSD<- ggplot(summary_stats, aes(x = Region, y = mean, color = Region, group = Region)) +
  geom_line(aes(group = Region), linewidth = 1) +  # Line connecting points by Cond
  geom_point(size = 3) +  # Plot the mean data points
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = mean - sd, ymax = mean + sd), width = 0.2) +  # Error bars for SD
  facet_wrap(~ Region, scales = "free_x") +  # Faceting by Level
  labs(title = "Mean Densities by Condition and Level with Standard Deviation",
       x = "Region",
       y = "Mean Freq") +
  theme_minimal()

print(plotFqCSD)

# Print the plot

ggsave('plotFqCSE.eps', units = "cm", width = 10, height = 6, dpi = 300)

ggsave('plotFqCSD.eps', units = "cm", width = 10, height = 6, dpi = 300)

```

    facet_wrap(~ Region) +
    labs(title = "Mean Densities by Condition and Level with Standard Deviation",
         x = "Condition",
         y = "Mean perc") +

### d3) STATISTICAL analysis data for modulation of PKD2L1 N**p Open %** in pH5

### =\> Linear model 2 Factors

#### \# Define Linear Model -) region \* Cond

```{r}


print("1- Analyse per condition")

kruskal.test(Perc~Cond, data = pO5)

library(rcompanion)


pairwise.wilcox.test(Perc, Cond,
                 p.adjust.method = "BH")

Sum = groupwiseMean(Perc ~ Cond,
                    data   = pO5,
                   conf   = 0.95,
                   digits = 3,
                   traditional = FALSE,
                    percentile  = TRUE)


print("2- Analyse per region")

kruskal.test(Perc~Region, data = pO5)

library(rcompanion)
pairwise.wilcox.test(Perc, Region,
                 p.adjust.method = "BH")

Sum = groupwiseMean(Perc ~ Region,
                    data   = pO5,
                   conf   = 0.95,
                   digits = 3,
                   traditional = FALSE,
                    percentile  = TRUE)


modelP5 = lm(Perc ~ Region*Cond,
           data = pO5)
# Summary overall p-value and r-square 
summary(modelP5)


```

#### \## Conduct analysis of variance, Type II sum of squares

```{r}
# Conduct analysis of variance, Type II sum of squares

library(car)
Anova(modelP5,type = "II")
```

#### \### Post-hoc analysis: mean separation tests

```{r}

library(multcompView)
library(emmeans)
leastsquare = emmeans(modelP5,
                      ~ Cond*Region,
                      adjust = "sidak")
leastsquare

EMM <- emmeans(modelP5, ~ Cond*Region)
EMM    # display the cell means

### Simple pairwise comparisons...
pairs(EMM, simple = "Cond")    # compare treats for each dose -- "simple effects"
pairs(EMM, simple = "Region")     # compare doses for each treat

```
